snippet.title: Halloween 2025 Pac Man Game Google Doodle Link Beat All Levels All Treats With Ending
snippet.description:
This game is an interactive Doodle that features a Halloween edition of PAC-MAN. Pac-Man is celebrating 45 years of this classic game.

The Halloween Pacman Link can be found at:
https://doodles.google/doodle/pac-man-halloween-2025-edition/
The 30th Anniversary Pacman Google Doodle Link:
https://www.google.com/logos/2010/pacman10-i.html
